requirements.case: Covington receipts, intervals and Sydney Mail/de Beer layers
requirements.requirement: Preserve Covington letters as Darwin’s dated responses to approximate or explicit receipts: 1477 receives the June 1851 letter about two months earlier and notes Berrill two days earlier; 1538 records the May 25 1853 letter received October 11; 1637 records the August 8 1854 letter received about six weeks earlier. Keep Sydney Mail transcription wording and later de Beer correction or normalization layers separate, with no fabricated exact dispatch or receipt day. De Beer normalization is an editorial explanation for discrepant transcripts, not an authorized correction to adopt. Preserve Sydney Mail Pambala and He for Fuegia with separate editorial correction fields, and attribute the embedded loyal-subjects quotation in1637 to Covington rather than Darwin.
